note: Commitment level C2 sets the floor at 50% of lines and 50% of files. The thresholds below are pinned just under the measurement, so an ordinary regression fails the gate rather than passing it, and they rise as coverage rises. Never re-record them downwards without attributing the drop. Read by projects/marketing/vitest.config.mjs and by tools/coverage-files-gate/run.js.
measuredOver: Every file vitest.config.mjs names in coverage.include: the app routes, the components and lib. Tests cover behaviour — the booking dialog's escape handling and scroll lock, the provider's context, the software tabs — plus one rendering assertion per page section. Presentational markup is not asserted line by line.
